subject.title: feat(tools/write): add append mode for agent writes

question: Which append-capable write contract and landing branch should OpenClaw accept for the canonical write-tool data-loss issue?
rationale: The bug and append direction are well-supported, but the permanent model-facing API shape and whether to land this broad branch or the narrower competing PR are maintainer-owned product and upgrade decisions.

options.title: Accept `append?: boolean` and pick one branch
options.body: Land this PR after explicit scope review, or prefer the narrower competing PR if maintainers want the same API with less unrelated drift.

options.title: Require a different append API
options.body: Ask for `mode` or a dedicated append tool if maintainers want a more explicit or extensible file-write contract before merge.

options.title: Defer first-class append
options.body: Keep write overwrite-only and rely on prompts/workarounds, accepting the linked data-loss risk until a later design is sponsored.

recommendation.title: Accept `append?: boolean` and pick one branch
recommendation.body: Land this PR after explicit scope review, or prefer the narrower competing PR if maintainers want the same API with less unrelated drift.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available owner signal for the agent runtime/tool API boundary and related product-direction choice.
